name: Exp_Waddah_Attar_Trend
summary: This EA implements the Waddah Attar Trend indicator-based trading strategy, which combines MACD and Bollinger Bands to identify trend direction and strength. It enters long positions when the indicator shows a bullish trend with sufficient momentum and short positions for bearish trends, exiting when the trend weakens or reverses. The EA applies a systematic trend-following approach with configurable parameters for sensitivity and risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于Waddah Attar Trend指标的交易策略，结合MACD和布林带来识别趋势方向和强度。当指标显示看涨趋势且动量充足时做多，看跌趋势时做空，在趋势减弱或反转时平仓。EA采用系统化的趋势跟踪方法，具有可配置的灵敏度和风险管理参数。
strategy_analysis: Waddah Attar Trend策略的核心概念是将MACD的动量信号与布林带的波动性结合，构建一个综合趋势判断指标。入场条件方面，当指标柱状图为正且超过阈值时开多单，为负且超过阈值时开空单，这确保了只在趋势明确时才进场。出场条件包括趋势减弱（柱状图缩小到阈值以下）或出现反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设置交易量。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈设置，但整体依赖趋势持续性来获取利润，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。该策略在强趋势市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The Waddah Attar Trend strategy's core concept combines MACD momentum signals with Bollinger Bands volatility to create a comprehensive trend assessment indicator. For entry conditions, a long position is opened when the histogram is positive and exceeds a configurable threshold, and a short position when negative and exceeding the threshold, ensuring trades only occur when trends are well-established. Exit conditions include closing positions when the trend weakens (histogram shrinks below threshold) or when a reversal signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user can set the trading volume through input parameters. Money management provides stop loss and take profit settings, but overall relies on trend persistence for profit generation, lacking a dynamic position adjustment mechanism. The strategy performs well in strong trending markets but may produce frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: InpSensitivity
parameters.description: 趋势灵敏度阈值，控制入场信号强度
parameters.description_en: Trend sensitivity threshold, controls entry signal strength

parameters.name: InpMagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 结合MACD和布林带双重确认，趋势判断较为可靠
灵敏度参数可调，适应不同市场环境
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数直观
仅在趋势明确时进场，减少了震荡市的假信号
支持止损止盈设置，具备基本风险控制
pros_en: Dual confirmation from MACD and Bollinger Bands provides relatively reliable trend identification
Adjustable sensitivity parameter allows adaptation to different market conditions
Clear and understandable strategy logic with intuitive parameters
Only enters when trend is well-established, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Supports stop loss and take profit settings with basic risk control
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金自动调整
默认止损止盈为0，新手使用可能面临无限风险
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易频繁亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本较高
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, cannot auto-adjust based on account equity
Default stop loss and take profit are zero, posing unlimited risk for inexperienced users
Trend following strategy prone to frequent losses in ranging or choppy markets
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No spread filter, leading to high entry costs in wide spread environments
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR自动调整手数
添加新K线检查和时间过滤机制，避免重复交易和非活跃时段入场
加入点差过滤和震荡市识别机制，减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that auto-adjusts lot size based on account balance and ATR
Implement new bar check and time filter mechanisms to prevent duplicate trades and entries during inactive sessions
Incorporate spread filter and ranging market detection to reduce trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
